title: The Slim girl in the photograph
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：slim　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 slim 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the headmaster wrote of ① a slim girl in the photograph in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② slimmer than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the slim ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the slimmest girl in the photograph anybody in the school had ever seen, or so the record for October 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too slim to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the slim ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a slim chance of success, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as slim as the chance of success they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was slim or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something slim, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite slim; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the slim ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, with great care, she wrote of another slim girl in the photograph in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ slimmer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The slimmest chance of success in the whole school, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the slim ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 苗条（前置定语 a slim girl in the photograph：1989 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件苗条的姑娘）
B. adj. 苗条／微小（比较级 slimmer than：文中两处，一处比照片里苗条的姑娘，一处比预想）
C. adj. 苗条／微小（最高级 the slimmest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 苗条（表语 too slim to do：母亲觉得它太苗条，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 微小（前置定语 a slim chance of success：叔叔把整件事称作一桩微小的机会）
F. adj. 微小（同级比较 as slim as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩成功的微小机会相比）
G. adj. 微小（后置定语 something slim：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 微小（受程度副词修饰 quite slim：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a slim girl in the photograph
the slimmest girl in the photograph anybody
The slimmest chance of success in

answers.why: slim 意为“苗条”，1989 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件苗条的姑娘”，此处作前置定语 a slim girl in the photograph。
slim 意为“苗条”，此处用比较级 slimmer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
slim 意为“苗条”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说它是学堂里最苗条的一件，故用最高级 the slimmest girl in the photograph。
slim 意为“苗条”，母亲认为这件东西“太苗条了，谁也用不上”，too slim to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
slim 意为“微小”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩微小的机会”，此处作前置定语 a slim chance of success。
slim 意为“微小”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩成功的微小机会一样微小”，同级比较用 as slim as。
slim 意为“微小”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“微小的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something slim。
slim 意为“微小”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当微小”，quite 修饰原级 slim。
slim 意为“微小”，1999 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要微小”，故用比较级 slimmer than。
slim 意为“微小”，母亲 2001 年说的是“整个学堂里最微小的那一桩”，故用最高级 the slimmest chance of success。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件苗条的姑娘。（a slim girl in the photograph）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更苗条。（slimmer than …）
母亲觉得它太苗条，谁也用不上。（too slim to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩微小的机会。（a slim chance of success）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩成功的微小机会一样微小。（as slim as …）
到了 1996 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件微小的东西。（something slim）
answers: In 1989 the headmaster wrote of a slim girl in the photograph in the record.
Everybody said it was slimmer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too slim to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a slim chance of success.
He said nobody would call it as slim as the chance of success they had once had.
By 1996 the record asked for nothing but something slim.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 slim 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the headmaster wrote of a slim girl in the photograph in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the slimmest girl in the photograph in the school, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too slim to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a slim chance of success, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite slim, and everybody laughed.
The slim ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
